name: Advanced Addons, Theme & Core Exporter
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Advanced Addons, Theme & Core Exporter gives you complete control to export your site’s plugins, themes, and WordPress core files — individually or combined — in a single ZIP package.

This tool is perfect for:

  • Website migration
  • Local development setup
  • Backup before updates
  • Manual plugin/theme version archiving
  • WordPress debugging

Simply go to Tools → Advanced Addons, Theme & Core Exporter and download anything with one click.

Supports both ZipArchive and WordPress PclZip fallback, ensuring it works on all servers.

🚀 Key Features

🔌 Export Installed Plugins

  • List of all active & inactive plugins
  • See version, file size, and main file path
  • Download each plugin as a ZIP
  • Works directly from plugin listing page

🎨 Export Installed Themes

  • Export active and inactive themes
  • Shows version, template folder, and size
  • One-click download for each theme
  • Works on the Themes screen and plugin export page

🧩 Export WordPress Core (Multiple Options)

You can export different parts of the WordPress installation:

  • Full WordPress Files (100%)
    Exports all WordPress files & folders (except wp-config.php for security)

  • Full WordPress Core Folders
    Downloads wp-admin + wp-includes + main core files

  • Uploads Folder (wp-content/uploads)
    Includes images, media, and backups

  • wp-content Only (Excluding Uploads)
    Useful for migrating themes/plugins only

  • wp-admin Only

  • wp-includes Only

  • Full Database (SQL)
    Exports your entire database as .sql

📦 Combine Everything Into One ZIP

You can select multiple core options and generate one combined ZIP using:

  • “Export selected WordPress core options (checked above) into the combined ZIP”

🔐 Secure & Compatible

  • Works with ZipArchive (if installed)
  • Falls back to PclZip automatically
  • Respects WordPress file permissions
  • Admin-only access
  • Nonce-protected export operations

🖥 Sleek, Admin-Friendly Interface

  • Clean table layout with plugin/theme details
  • Modern UI matching WordPress style
  • Built for clarity and reliability

📂 How It Works

Go to:

Tools → Advanced Plugin, Theme & Core Exporter

You will find three sections:

1️⃣ Installed Plugins

→ View plugin name, version, size
→ Click Download to export ZIP

2️⃣ Installed Themes

→ Shows theme version, size, folder
→ One-click Download

3️⃣ WordPress Core Export

→ Toggle any export option
→ Click Download
→ Or select multiple and click Create & Download ZIP

🔧 Installation

  1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Tools → Advanced Addons, Theme & Core Exporter
  4. Download plugins, themes, or WordPress core as needed

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

1. Does this export plugins and themes as ZIP files?

Yes. Each plugin/theme downloads as a clean ZIP archive.

2. Will this export my database too?

Yes — simply enable the Download Full Database option.

3. Can I create a combined ZIP with multiple folders inside?

Yes — enable multiple checkboxes and click Create & Download ZIP.

4. Does this work even if ZipArchive is missing on my server?

Yes — it automatically uses WordPress-built PclZip fallback.

5. Are wp-config.php or sensitive files included?

For security, wp-config.php is excluded unless the user manually adds it.

6. Who can access this tool?

Only Administrators (capability: manage_options).

📸 Screenshots

  1. Installed Addons Export Interface
  2. Installed Themes Export Interface
  3. WordPress Core Export Options

📝 Changelog

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Addons exporter with size & version info
  • Theme exporter with template details
  • WordPress core export system
  • Download full database (SQL)
  • Combined ZIP export feature
  • Fallback to PclZip if ZipArchive is unavailable
  • Added clean & responsive admin UI

🔔 Upgrade Notice

1.0.0

First stable release — includes complete Addons, theme, and core export system.
